mapper.select: select 1 as tree_level , og.sys_id , og.link_sys_id as parent_sys_id , concat('주문 #', og.order_num) as item_name , null as qty , null as price , null as total_price , null as payment_yn, og.order_status, og.cancel_reason, og.cancel_description from order_group og where 1=1 and og.link_sys_id = #{masterSysId} union all select 2 as tree_level , od.sys_id , od.link_sys_id3 as parent_sys_id , smd.menu_name as item_name , od.qty , smd.menu_price as price , case when od.payment_yn = 'Y' then smd.menu_price * od.qty else 0 end as total_price , od.payment_yn, null as order_status, null as cancel_reason, null as cancel_description from order_detail od inner join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join store_menu_detail smd on smd.sys_id = od.link_sys_id2 where 1=1 and og.link_sys_id = #{masterSysId} union all select 3 as tree_level , odo.sys_id , odo.link_sys_id as parent_sys_id , smod.menu_option_name as item_name , odo.qty , smod.menu_option_price as price , case when od.payment_yn = 'Y' then smod.menu_option_price * odo.qty else 0 end as total_price , od.payment_yn, null as order_status, null as cancel_reason, null as cancel_description from order_detail_option odo inner join order_detail od on od.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id inner join order_group og on og.sys_id = od.link_sys_id3 left join store_menu_option_detail smod on smod.sys_id = odo.link_sys_id2 where 1=1 and og.link_sys_id = #{masterSysId} order by tree_level asc
